data.name: Irenka
data.gender_notes: Irenka is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Irene', meaning 'peace'. In ancient Greece, Irene was the goddess of peace and tranquility. In Christianity, Irene represents virtue, purity, and peace. The name Irenka carries the meaning “Peace, Virtue” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Irenka usually hope their child will grow to embody peace, virtue and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing inner peace and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Irenka belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Peace, Virtue.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Irenka total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: אירקה
in_hebrew.meaning: שלום, שלווה, חסד, רחמים, השלום הנצחי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אירקה היא שם יהודי-נוצרי המקורב לעברית. השם אירקה יצא מהשם איר, הפועל לשלום ולשלווה. המשמעות הכללית של השם היא שלום, שלווה, חסד, רחמים, השלום הנצחי. בשנת 2016, השם אירקה נכלל ברשימת 100 השמות הנפוצים ביותר בארצות הברית. במסורת הנוצרית, השם אירקה נועד לסמל את השלום הגלובלי, שכביכול יבוא עם ישוע.

in_greek.name: Ἰρένκα
in_greek.meaning: ἔρως, εἰρήνη, χάρις, ἐλέος, αἰώνιος εἰρήνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἰρένκα ἐστὶ ὀνοματεπώνυμος Ἕλλην-Χριστιανός, ὁστιὲς ἀπὸ τὸ Ἑβραϊκόν. Ἡ ῥῆσις Ἰρένκα ἀπὸ τοῦ ἄρχεγοντος Ἰρέν, ὁ σημαίνει εἰρήνην καὶ καρδίαν ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἑβραϊκοῦ. Ἡ σημασία τῆς ῥῆσης εἶναι εἰρήνη, εἰρήνη, χάρις, ἐλέος, αἰώνιος εἰρήνη. Ἡ ῥῆσις Ἰρένκα ἐν τῷ 2016 ἐκδιδομένη ἐν τῇ λιστῇ τῶν 100 ὀνοματοποιων πλέον ἐν τῇ Αμερικαῖς. Ἡ μνημοσύνη τῆς ῥῆσης Ἰρένκα ἐν τῇ Χριστιανικῇ Ἐκκλησίᾳ, εἶναι τὸν εἰσπορεύειν εἰρήνην, σιγὴν, σιγὴν, σιγὴν, σιγὴν αἰωνίαν.

in_latin.name: Irenka
in_latin.meaning: amor, pax, gratia, misericordia, perpetua pax
in_latin.long_meaning: Irenka est nomen Christianum, a nomine Hebraico derivatum. Nomen Irenka a verbo Iren, significante pacem et caritatem, trahitur. Significatio nominis est amor, pax, gratia, misericordia, perpetua pax. In anno 2016, nomen Irenka inclusum est in lista nominum 100 frequentissimorum in Civitatibus Foederatis. In traditione Christiana, nomen Irenka significat pacem, silentium, silentium, silentium, silentium perpetuum.

in_english.name: Irenka
in_english.meaning: peace, love, kindness, mercy, eternal peace
in_english.long_meaning: Irenka is a Christian name derived from the Hebrew name. The name Irenka comes from the word Iren, meaning peace and love. The general meaning of the name is peace, love, kindness, mercy, eternal peace. In 2016, the name Irenka was included in the list of 100 most popular names in the United States. In Christian tradition, the name Irenka is meant to symbolize global peace, which is believed to come with Jesus. Irenka is a unique and lovely name that conveys a sense of calm and serenity. It is also associated with qualities such as kindness, compassion, and empathy. In modern culture, the name Irenka is gaining popularity as a symbol of peace and love.
